description: This file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\DefaultsMode namespace. It provides methods to create configuration providers for AWS SDK default modes, supporting environment variables, ini files, fallbacks, and caching mechanisms. The class includes several static methods to generate these providers and mechanisms to resolve configuration asynchronously using promises.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides static methods to generate AWS SDK configuration providers based on environment variables, ini files, fallback options, and caching, supporting asynchronous configuration resolution.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider chain, optionally using a cache.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Provides configuration based on environment variables.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration if other sources are unavailable.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates configuration from ini files, with optional profile and filename parameters.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Resolves a configuration object or promise into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
